title: Small tree circuit for every Boolean function
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables, there is a Boolean circuit tree that computes the function on every assignment and has size at most $2^n(n+1)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative integer number of variables
A Boolean function on assignments to those variables
